A calculator that shows its working: exact answers, up to 1000-digit precision, and step-by-step
solutions for algebra, calculus, equations, matrices, statistics, units, graphs and geometry.

## Which file do I need?

### Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `ProCalc_*_x64-setup.exe` | **Recommended.** Installer with Start menu shortcut and uninstaller |
| `ProCalc_*_x64_en-US.msi` | Installer for managed or company PCs |
| `ProCalc_*_windows_x64_portable.zip` | No install: unzip and run `ProCalc.exe` |

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the app isn't code-signed yet: choose
**More info → Run anyway**. The portable version needs Microsoft Edge WebView2, which
Windows 11 already has.

### Linux (64-bit)

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `ProCalc_*_amd64.AppImage` | **Works on most distributions.** `chmod +x` it, then run it |
| `ProCalc_*_amd64.deb` | Debian, Ubuntu, Linux Mint, Pop!_OS: `sudo apt install ./ProCalc_*_amd64.deb` |
| `ProCalc-*.x86_64.rpm` | Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL: `sudo dnf install ./ProCalc-*.x86_64.rpm` |
| `ProCalc_*_linux_x64_portable.zip` / `.tar.gz` | No install: unpack and run `./procalc` (needs WebKitGTK 4.1, e.g. `libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0`) |

## Found a problem?

Please [open an issue](https://github.com/KimsFerdy/ProCalc/issues) with the exact input
that surprised you.
